title: 自然对话引擎
goal: 会追问、澄清、转折和接话，能把熟悉话题继续聊下去。
basis: 参考 PHRASE List 的多词表达选材方法及 Spoken BNC2014 的日常会话方向。例句与提示为原创。

units.title: 接话、思考与澄清
units.goal: 在回答前自然留一点思考时间，并核对自己听懂的意思。

cards.en: Could you give me a second while I check my calendar?
cards.zh: 能给我一点时间查一下日程吗？
cards.trigger_context: 同事等你查日程，只需几秒。
cards.disambiguator: 手头的小动作能立刻做完，想让对方先等你一下。
cards.usage_boundary: 口语里用 a second 表示很短的一会儿，长时间等待要另外说明。
cards.feynman_hook: 我马上就能接着说，先给我查一下。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 接电话时请对方等你打开邮件。
cards.transfer_example_en: Could you give me a second while I open that email?
cards.cloze_prompt: Could you [g___] [m_] [a_] [s_____] while I check my calendar?

cards.en: Let me think. I went to some great shows last year.
cards.zh: 让我想想。去年我看过几场很棒的演出。
cards.trigger_context: 朋友突然问你最喜欢哪场演出。
cards.disambiguator: 先想答案。
cards.feynman_hook: 脑子里还没选好答案，我先想一想。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 店员问你想选什么颜色。
cards.transfer_example_en: Let me think. I might go with the blue one.
cards.cloze_prompt: [L__] [m_] [t____]. I went to some great shows last year.

cards.target_chunk: off the top of my head
cards.chunk_in_sentence: off the top of my head
cards.en: Off the top of my head, there's a good bakery on King Street.
cards.zh: 我一时想到的是金街有家不错的面包店。
cards.trigger_context: 有人问附近哪家面包店不错，你随口想到一家。
cards.disambiguator: 临时回想。
cards.feynman_hook: 我不查资料，先报一个现在就想得到的。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 随口估算来回车费。
cards.transfer_example_en: Off the top of my head, it's about twenty dollars return.
cards.cloze_prompt: [O__] [t__] [t__] [o_] [m_] [h___], there's a good bakery on King Street.

cards.en: Now that you mention it, I think I left the car window open.
cards.zh: 你这么一说，我好像忘关车窗了。
cards.trigger_context: 对方提到车窗没关，你忽然想起下雨的事。
cards.disambiguator: 对方提醒后才想起。
cards.feynman_hook: 你一提这事，我才把它想起来。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 对方提到图书馆，想起还书期限。
cards.transfer_example_en: Now that you mention it, my library books are due tomorrow.
cards.cloze_prompt: [N__] [t___] [y__] [m______] [i_], I think I left the car window open.

cards.en: Come to think of it, I did see him in the lift yesterday.
cards.zh: 仔细想想，我昨天确实在电梯里见到过他。
cards.trigger_context: 说完自己没见过邻居，又想起在电梯里遇到过。
cards.disambiguator: 回头想后追加或修正。
cards.feynman_hook: 我再倒回去想了一下，哎，还真有一件漏说的。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 忽然想起漏订了一晚旅馆。
cards.transfer_example_en: Come to think of it, we haven't booked a room for Friday.
cards.cloze_prompt: [C___] [t_] [t____] [o_] [i_], I did see him in the lift yesterday.

cards.en: What do you mean by flexible hours?
cards.zh: 你说的弹性工时具体是什么意思？
cards.trigger_context: 对方用 flexible 描述上班时间，你觉得含糊。
cards.disambiguator: 问一个词或说法具体指什么。
cards.feynman_hook: 同一个词两个人可能理解不同，这里请对方说具体。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 问卖家所谓的轻微划痕有多明显。
cards.transfer_example_en: What do you mean by minor scratches?
cards.cloze_prompt: [W___] [d_] [y__] [m___] [b_] flexible hours?

cards.en: Do you mean we should meet at six instead?
cards.zh: 你的意思是改成六点见吗？
cards.trigger_context: 朋友说把晚餐改早，你要确认是不是六点。
cards.disambiguator: 给出你的理解请对方确认。
cards.feynman_hook: 我已经猜到一种意思，拿这个猜测跟你对一对。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 确认周五指这周还是下周。
cards.transfer_example_en: Do you mean this Friday or next Friday?
cards.cloze_prompt: [D_] [y__] [m___] we should meet at six instead?

cards.en: Just to be clear, we're meeting at the south entrance, right?
cards.zh: 我确认一下，我们在南入口见，对吧？
cards.trigger_context: 约人见面，怕认错车站入口。
cards.disambiguator: 先说明要核对一项细节。
cards.feynman_hook: 我想把关键细节对准，免得两个人各按各的理解走。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 确认报价是否含送货。
cards.transfer_example_en: Just to be clear, does that price include delivery?
cards.cloze_prompt: [J___] [t_] [b_] [c____], we're meeting at the south entrance, right?

cards.en: If I've got this right, I'll cover Monday and you'll take Tuesday.
cards.zh: 如果我理解得对，我顶周一，你上周二。
cards.trigger_context: 同事解释调班，你把两人的新班次复述一遍。
cards.disambiguator: 复述整个安排供核对。
cards.feynman_hook: 我先用自己的话说一遍，看看有没有哪一步抄错。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 复述退货规则请店员核实。
cards.transfer_example_en: If I've got this right, I have thirty days to return it.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I_] [I___] [g__] [t___] [r____], I'll cover Monday and you'll take Tuesday.

cards.en: Can you say that again? I missed the room number.
cards.zh: 能再说一遍吗？我没听清房间号。
cards.trigger_context: 电话里杂音盖住了刚报出的房号。
cards.disambiguator: 请求重说。
cards.feynman_hook: 刚才那句没进耳朵，请原样再说一次。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 咖啡馆太吵，没听清朋友说什么。
cards.transfer_example_en: Can you say that again? It's noisy in here.
cards.cloze_prompt: [C__] [y__] [s__] [t___] [a____]? I missed the room number.

cards.en: Could you go through that a bit more slowly?
cards.zh: 能稍微慢一点再讲一遍吗？
cards.trigger_context: 听到了路线说明，但对方语速太快。
cards.disambiguator: 请求调慢速度。
cards.feynman_hook: 话说得密，我想让每几个词之间多留一点时间。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 请前台慢点报 Wi-Fi 密码。
cards.transfer_example_en: Could you read the password a bit more slowly?
cards.cloze_prompt: Could you go through that [a_] [b__] [m___] [s_____]?

cards.en: What was that last part? I got the street name.
cards.zh: 最后那段是什么？街道名我听清了。
cards.trigger_context: 地址前半段听清了，只漏了结尾。
cards.disambiguator: 只重听末尾。
cards.feynman_hook: 前面我已经跟上，只要补上漏掉的结尾。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 没听到说明最后一个步骤。
cards.transfer_example_en: What was that last part? I heard everything up to the login step.
cards.cloze_prompt: [W___] [w__] [t___] [l___] [p___]? I got the street name.

cards.en: I see what you mean. That's a long way to go every morning.
cards.zh: 我明白你的意思。每天早上确实要跑很远。
cards.trigger_context: 听完朋友解释为什么通勤太远，你表示理解。
cards.disambiguator: 确认理解对方的理由。
cards.feynman_hook: 我能顺着你的思路走一遍，知道你为什么这么说。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 同事解释临时改安排会影响交接。
cards.transfer_example_en: I see what you mean. Changing it now would make the handover harder.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I_] [s__] [w___] [y__] [m___]. That's a long way to go every morning.

cards.en: That makes sense. I didn't realise the depot was closed.
cards.zh: 这就说得通了。我之前不知道仓库关了。
cards.trigger_context: 对方解释包裹为什么晚到。
cards.disambiguator: 认可解释符合逻辑。
cards.feynman_hook: 原来是这一步出了问题，现在前因后果接得上了。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 听到朋友解释为何早起运动。
cards.transfer_example_en: That makes sense. It's much cooler at that time.
cards.cloze_prompt: [T___] [m____] [s____]. I didn't realise the depot was closed.

cards.en: Are you saying we need to redo the whole report?
cards.zh: 你是说我们得把报告全部重做吗？
cards.trigger_context: 听到老师的新安排，你核对是否要重做整份报告。
cards.disambiguator: 核对容易误解的含意。
cards.usage_boundary: 语气太重可能显得质问。
cards.feynman_hook: 我是按这个意思听出来的，想请你确认一下。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 确认朋友是否建议改坐公交。
cards.transfer_example_en: Are you saying we'd be better off taking the bus?
cards.cloze_prompt: [A__] [y__] [s_____] we need to redo the whole report?

cards.en: What's the difference between the local pass and the regional pass?
cards.zh: 本地通票和区域通票有什么区别？
cards.trigger_context: 想买周票，没分清两种票的使用范围。
cards.disambiguator: 请对方比较两个选项。
cards.feynman_hook: 把两个东西放到一起比，我才知道选哪一个。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 问同事两个文件状态的区别。
cards.transfer_example_en: What's the difference between a draft and a pending review?
cards.cloze_prompt: [W_____] [t__] [d_________] [b______] the local pass and the regional pass?

cards.en: How does that work? Do you unlock the bike with your phone?
cards.zh: 那具体怎么操作？是用手机给车解锁吗？
cards.trigger_context: 朋友提到共享单车可以按天租，你想了解流程。
cards.disambiguator: 询问机制或步骤。
cards.feynman_hook: 我想弄明白这个办法实际跑起来是什么样。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 问活动现场如何排队候补。
cards.transfer_example_en: How does that work? Do I leave my phone number with you?
cards.cloze_prompt: [H__] [d___] [t___] [w___]? Do you unlock the bike with your phone?

cards.en: As far as I know, the pool closes at nine.
cards.zh: 据我所知，泳池九点关门。
cards.trigger_context: 别人问泳池几点关，你只知道平常的时间。
cards.disambiguator: 限定已知信息。
cards.feynman_hook: 把话说到我所知道的范围为止。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 说出自己印象里的退换截止日。
cards.transfer_example_en: As far as I know, we have until Monday to return it.
cards.cloze_prompt: [A_] [f__] [a_] [I_] [k___], the pool closes at nine.

cards.en: I could be wrong, but I think they close on Wednesdays.
cards.zh: 我可能记错了，但我印象里他们周三休息。
cards.trigger_context: 你觉得某家店星期三休息，但没有把握。
cards.disambiguator: 主动承认不确定。
cards.feynman_hook: 我愿意先给一个猜测，也给自己留一点出错空间。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 不确定车是否停靠中途小站。
cards.transfer_example_en: I could be wrong, but I think this train skips Oak Street.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I_] [c____] [b_] [w____], but I think they close on Wednesdays.

cards.en: If I remember correctly, we stayed at the place next to the river.
cards.zh: 如果我没记错，我们住的是河边那家。
cards.trigger_context: 朋友问上次订的是哪家民宿，你要凭记忆回答。
cards.disambiguator: 给记忆加限定。
cards.usage_boundary: 适用于过去知道的细节。
cards.feynman_hook: 我印象里是这么回事，可能记岔了。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 凭记忆复述以前约定过的截止日期。
cards.transfer_example_en: If I remember correctly, the deadline was the last day of June.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I_] [I_] [r_______] [c________], we stayed at the place next to the river.

units.title: 表达保留、异议与程度
units.goal: 保留自己的判断，同时给对方留有回应空间。

cards.en: It depends on how busy the roads are.
cards.zh: 得看路上有多忙。
cards.trigger_context: 别人问骑车上班好不好，你认为取决于路况。
cards.disambiguator: 给出具体决定因素。
cards.feynman_hook: 把决定答案的变量说出来，让对方知道什么时候选哪边。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 买大桌子前考虑房间尺寸。
cards.transfer_example_en: It depends on how much space you have.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I_] [d______] [o_] how busy the roads are.

cards.en: I'm not so sure we'll make it in half an hour.
cards.zh: 我不太确定我们能在半小时内到。
cards.trigger_context: 朋友说能半小时到，你觉得高峰期不一定。
cards.disambiguator: 软化怀疑或小幅异议。
cards.feynman_hook: 我听懂了你的判断，只是对它能不能成立还有保留。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 礼貌质疑某款便宜耳机会耐用。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'm not so sure those headphones will last.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I__] [n__] [s_] [s___] we'll make it in half an hour.

cards.en: I wouldn't go that far. The soup was pretty good.
cards.zh: 我倒不会说得那么严重。汤其实不错。
cards.chunk_zh: 我倒不会说到那个程度
cards.trigger_context: 朋友把一般难吃的饭说成他吃过最糟的。
cards.disambiguator: 对方用了很绝对或很强烈的说法，你同意其中的一部分。
cards.usage_boundary: 常单独回应对方刚说的判断，再补一句自己接受到什么程度。
cards.feynman_hook: 我跟你走到一半，后面那个很重的评价我跟不上。
cards.explanation: 我倒不会说到那个程度
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 对方说从家办公就等于没有团队合作。
cards.transfer_example_en: I wouldn't go that far. We still talk every day.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I_] [w_______] [g_] [t___] [f__]. The soup was pretty good.

cards.en: I can see why people find that rule frustrating.
cards.zh: 我理解大家为什么会对那条规则感到不满。
cards.trigger_context: 收银员解释顾客为何对规则不满。
cards.disambiguator: 承认理由或感受可以理解。
cards.feynman_hook: 先站到对方的位置，看过去为什么会有这种反应。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 理解朋友舍不得搬离熟悉的社区。
cards.transfer_example_en: I can see why you'd want to stay in this neighbourhood.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I_] [c__] [s__] [w__] people find that rule frustrating.

cards.en: I get your point, but we still need someone to check the figures.
cards.zh: 我明白你的观点，但还是需要有人核对数字。
cards.trigger_context: 同事重视速度，你认可他的考虑，仍要补充。
cards.disambiguator: 先接住论点。
cards.feynman_hook: 我接到了你抛出的理由，再说说它漏掉的那一面。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 认同买二手更便宜，再指出保修问题。
cards.transfer_example_en: I get your point, but a new one comes with a warranty.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I_] [g__] [y___] [p____], but we still need someone to check the figures.

cards.en: The commute is tiring. Having said that, the office is in a good spot.
cards.zh: 通勤挺累的。话虽如此，办公室的位置不错。
cards.trigger_context: 你觉得通勤辛苦，同时承认办公室位置挺方便。
cards.disambiguator: 给前述判断补充反向因素。
cards.feynman_hook: 前一句有道理，另一个事实也得算进去。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 承认公寓小，再说采光好。
cards.transfer_example_en: The flat is small. Having said that, it gets a lot of light.
cards.cloze_prompt: The commute is tiring. [H_____] [s___] [t___], the office is in a good spot.

cards.en: To be fair, it's their first day being open.
cards.zh: 公平地说，今天是他们开业第一天。
cards.trigger_context: 有人嫌服务慢，你提醒大家这是营业第一天。
cards.disambiguator: 补上被忽略的有利事实。
cards.feynman_hook: 想把评价说公平，先把刚才漏算的一点补回来。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 批评一个人迟到后补充公交停运的背景。
cards.transfer_example_en: To be fair, all the buses were cancelled that morning.
cards.cloze_prompt: [T_] [b_] [f___], it's their first day being open.

cards.en: Not necessarily. Some of the best classes I've taken were free.
cards.zh: 不一定。我上过的一些最好的课就是免费的。
cards.trigger_context: 朋友认定收费越高，课程就越好。
cards.disambiguator: 否定必然联系。
cards.feynman_hook: 这两件事有时一起发生，不过从前一件还推不出后一件一定成立。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 有人认为住市中心肯定要有车。
cards.transfer_example_en: Not necessarily. The subway is good enough for most trips.
cards.cloze_prompt: [N__] [n__________]. Some of the best classes I've taken were free.

cards.en: Not quite. I'm leaving on Saturday, not on Friday.
cards.zh: 不完全是。我周六走，周五不走。
cards.trigger_context: 对方接近正确地复述了你的计划，但弄错了一点。
cards.disambiguator: 轻轻修正部分内容。
cards.feynman_hook: 已经很接近了，只差这一小处要改。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 买饮料时纠正对方说错的规格。
cards.transfer_example_en: Not quite. I asked for the smaller size.
cards.cloze_prompt: [N__] [q____]. I'm leaving on Saturday, not on Friday.

cards.en: More or less. I just need to pack my charger.
cards.zh: 差不多了，只剩充电器没装。
cards.trigger_context: 对方问你是不是已经收完行李。
cards.disambiguator: 表示整体接近完成或正确。
cards.feynman_hook: 大体对得上，零头还可能有出入。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 回答聚会人数是否约二十个。
cards.transfer_example_en: More or less. I think there were twenty-two of us.
cards.cloze_prompt: [M___] [o_] [l___]. I just need to pack my charger.

cards.en: I agree up to a point, but some people still need to walk in.
cards.zh: 我同意到一定程度，但还有人需要直接上门。
cards.trigger_context: 你同意预约方便，但觉得临时来访也得照顾。
cards.disambiguator: 明示同意有边界。
cards.feynman_hook: 我同意到这一步，再往前就得看别的条件。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 说说手机提醒多到什么程度会失去作用。
cards.transfer_example_en: Reminders help up to a point. After that, I just ignore them.
cards.cloze_prompt: I agree [u_] [t_] [a_] [p____], but some people still need to walk in.

cards.en: The workshop went well for the most part.
cards.zh: 这场工作坊总体进行得不错。
cards.trigger_context: 工作坊大部分环节顺利，投影却出了问题。
cards.disambiguator: 有可数出来的少数例外，整体判断依然成立。
cards.usage_boundary: 可以放在句首或句尾，常用于对整体表现、情况或趋势作评价。
cards.feynman_hook: 把绝大多数情况算在一起看，少数特殊时候另说。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 评价这次住店体验。
cards.transfer_example_en: For the most part, it was a comfortable stay.
cards.cloze_prompt: The workshop went well [f__] [t__] [m___] [p___].

cards.en: In a way, I'm glad the trip was cancelled.
cards.zh: 从一个角度看，旅行取消了我也挺庆幸。
cards.trigger_context: 计划取消有点失望，但你觉得也给了自己喘息时间。
cards.disambiguator: 只主张一种看法。
cards.feynman_hook: 转个角度看，原来看起来只有坏处的事也能有另一面。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 想想失败项目是否帮你看清工作偏好。
cards.transfer_example_en: In a way, that project helped me figure out what I enjoy.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I_] [a_] [w__], I'm glad the trip was cancelled.

cards.en: The jacket is a little on the tight side.
cards.zh: 这件外套有点偏紧。
cards.trigger_context: 朋友问外套合不合身，你觉得稍紧。
cards.disambiguator: 对本来差不多合适的东西作轻微的偏差评价。
cards.usage_boundary: 完整框架是 a little on the + 形容词 + side，例如 on the tight side。
cards.feynman_hook: 这个尺码没有彻底不合适，就是往某一边偏了一点。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 评价甜点略偏甜。
cards.transfer_example_en: The dessert was a little on the sweet side.
cards.cloze_prompt: The jacket is [a_] [l_____] [o_] [t__] tight side.

cards.en: Calling it a failure after one day is a bit of a stretch.
cards.zh: 才过一天就说它失败，有点牵强。
cards.trigger_context: 朋友只试用了一分钟，就说产品没人会买。
cards.disambiguator: 质疑根据有限的推断。
cards.feynman_hook: 这结论跨得有点远，刚才那点证据还够不到它。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 质疑把两次迟到说成总是迟到。
cards.transfer_example_en: Saying he's always late is a bit of a stretch.
cards.cloze_prompt: Calling it a failure after one day is [a_] [b__] [o_] [a_] [s______].

cards.en: I'd lean towards the quieter hotel.
cards.zh: 我会倾向于更安静的那家酒店。
cards.trigger_context: 两家酒店都行，你稍偏好更安静的那家。
cards.disambiguator: 给出初步偏好。
cards.feynman_hook: 我还在比较，不过目前天平略偏向这个。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 午餐时间在室内座位和露台间作初步选择。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'd lean towards sitting inside if it's windy.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I__] [l___] [t______] the quieter hotel.

cards.en: I'm torn between the shorter commute and the more interesting job.
cards.zh: 我在通勤更短和工作更有趣之间拿不定主意。
cards.trigger_context: 一份工作离家近，另一份更有趣。
cards.disambiguator: 表达两个选项各有吸引力。
cards.feynman_hook: 两边都有舍不得放下的地方，一下定不下来。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 面对两份菜单都喜欢的菜无法决定。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'm torn between the fish and the mushroom pasta.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I__] [t___] [b______] the shorter commute and the more interesting job.

cards.en: I wouldn't rule out flying if the fare is low enough.
cards.zh: 如果机票足够便宜，我也不会排除坐飞机。
cards.trigger_context: 你更想坐火车，但航班便宜时也愿考虑。
cards.disambiguator: 保留一个次选项。
cards.feynman_hook: 先把这个选项留在桌面上，条件合适仍然能选。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 备用方案是把会议移到线上。
cards.transfer_example_en: I wouldn't rule out moving the meeting online.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I_] [w_______] [r___] [o__] flying if the fare is low enough.

cards.en: That's a fair point. We do get a lot of rain in April.
cards.zh: 这点有道理。四月确实常下雨。
cards.trigger_context: 朋友指出骑车省钱但下雨不方便，你接受这个考虑。
cards.disambiguator: 认可一个具体理由。
cards.feynman_hook: 你指出的这个理由确实有分量，我把它算进去。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 同事提醒培训会占用休息日。
cards.transfer_example_en: That's a fair point. People might already have weekend plans.
cards.cloze_prompt: [T_____] [a_] [f___] [p____]. We do get a lot of rain in April.

cards.en: I'd put it differently. He's got too much on his plate.
cards.zh: 我会换个说法。他手头的事太多了。
cards.trigger_context: 对方把某位同事称作懒，你认为只是忙不过来。
cards.disambiguator: 修正看法的表述方式。
cards.feynman_hook: 我想重新描述同一件事，因为原来的说法容易让人看偏。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 把活动失败改说成宣传没到位。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'd put it differently. Most people didn't hear about the event.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I__] [p__] [i_] [d__________]. He's got too much on his plate.

units.title: 衔接、举例和总结
units.goal: 把一条观点、原因和例子讲成对方跟得上的一段话。

cards.en: I'd love to come. The thing is, I'm working that evening.
cards.zh: 我很想去。问题是我那天晚上要上班。
cards.trigger_context: 你得解释为何想去却去不了。
cards.disambiguator: 引出影响答案的具体情况。
cards.feynman_hook: 答案的关键在这里，我得先把这个实际情况说出来。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 解释为什么这周不能接新任务。
cards.transfer_example_en: The thing is, I'm already covering two other shifts.
cards.cloze_prompt: I'd love to come. [T__] [t____] [i_], I'm working that evening.

cards.en: What I mean is, let's move it to Friday, not cancel it.
cards.zh: 我的意思是改到周五，活动照常办。
cards.trigger_context: 别人把你的建议理解成取消活动，你其实想改期。
cards.disambiguator: 补述自己刚才想表达的意思。
cards.feynman_hook: 我把刚才说绕了的意思摊开讲清楚。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 澄清你想要更简单的版本。
cards.transfer_example_en: What I mean is, we can keep the idea and simplify the design.
cards.cloze_prompt: [W___] [I_] [m___] [i_], let's move it to Friday, not cancel it.

cards.en: Put it this way: I finish an entire podcast on the way there.
cards.zh: 这么说吧，我去的路上能听完一整期播客。
cards.trigger_context: 你不好直接评价路程远，用听得懂的比较来说明。
cards.disambiguator: 换个具体说法帮助理解。
cards.feynman_hook: 抽象的程度不好说，我换个你能一下想象出来的说法。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 形容某道菜辣到什么程度。
cards.transfer_example_en: Put it this way: I had to order a second glass of milk.
cards.cloze_prompt: [P__] [i_] [t___] [w__]: I finish an entire podcast on the way there.

cards.en: In other words, the day pass pays for itself after three rides.
cards.zh: 换句话说，坐三趟车日票就值回票价。
cards.trigger_context: 算完两种价格后，用一句话总结实际差多少。
cards.disambiguator: 重述同一个意思。
cards.feynman_hook: 还是刚才那个意思，我改成更直白的话再说一遍。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 重述提前预约才有座位的规则。
cards.transfer_example_en: In other words, you'll need to book ahead to get a seat.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I_] [o____] [w____], the day pass pays for itself after three rides.

cards.en: Take this as an example: last month, neighbours fixed twenty bikes together.
cards.zh: 以这个为例：上个月，邻居们一起修了二十辆自行车。
cards.trigger_context: 你想用一次社区活动说明组织志愿者的方式。
cards.disambiguator: 要举一个例子支撑观点，而非补讲另一个理由。
cards.usage_boundary: 先有观点再用这句转入例子，冒号后可直接讲实际经过。
cards.feynman_hook: 光讲道理有点抽象，我现在挑一件发生过的事来说明。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 举上周手写便签的方式说明如何提醒同事。
cards.transfer_example_en: Take this as an example: we left a note by the kettle and everyone saw it.
cards.cloze_prompt: [T___] [t___] [a_] [a_] [e______]: last month, neighbours fixed twenty bikes together.

cards.en: Last Saturday was a case in point: three trains were cancelled.
cards.zh: 上周六就是个典型例子，有三班火车取消了。
cards.trigger_context: 你说周末交通不稳定，想到上周的实际经历。
cards.disambiguator: 点出能支持刚才断言的例子。
cards.usage_boundary: 稍正式，用于有根据的论述。
cards.feynman_hook: 我刚说的现象，在这件具体事情里看得最清楚。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 解释早预约有帮助，举牙医停诊的例子。
cards.transfer_example_en: My dentist was a case in point; I couldn't get an appointment for weeks.
cards.cloze_prompt: Last Saturday was [a_] [c___] [i_] [p____]: three trains were cancelled.

cards.en: The walls are thin, and on top of that, the lift never works.
cards.zh: 墙很薄，而且电梯也总是坏。
cards.trigger_context: 提了公寓隔音差，又想加上一项不便。
cards.disambiguator: 补加同方向的因素。
cards.feynman_hook: 前面那一点已经成立，我还要再加一条同方向的理由。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 在活动免费之外再补一个吸引人的优点。
cards.transfer_example_en: The event is free, and on top of that, there's a bike repair stand.
cards.cloze_prompt: The walls are thin, and [o_] [t__] [o_] [t___], the lift never works.

cards.en: The power was out all evening, and that's why my phone died.
cards.zh: 整晚都停电，所以我的手机耗光了电。
cards.trigger_context: 说完停电的情况后解释为何手机没充上。
cards.disambiguator: 从刚交代的原因解释某个行为或结果，尤其适合回答 why。
cards.usage_boundary: 置于解释之后，用 and that's why 引出主语和动词组成的结果句。
cards.feynman_hook: 我先把缘由说明白，然后告诉你我为什么作了这个决定。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 先说错过早班车的原因再解释迟到。
cards.transfer_example_en: My alarm didn't go off, and that's why I missed the early bus.
cards.cloze_prompt: The power was out all evening, [a__] [t_____] [w__] my phone died.

cards.en: The last train's been cancelled, which means we'll need a taxi.
cards.zh: 末班车取消了，也就是说我们得叫出租车。
cards.trigger_context: 末班地铁取消，你要马上推导下一步。
cards.disambiguator: 从前一个事实推断直接后果，重点在接下来会怎样。
cards.usage_boundary: 常作逗号后的补充说明，which 承接前面整件事，means 后可接完整句。
cards.feynman_hook: 刚听到这个消息，就能知道下一步必须怎么做。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 听到店里周日当天休息，推导取货时间。
cards.transfer_example_en: They're closed on Sunday, which means we have to pick it up on Saturday.
cards.cloze_prompt: The last train's been cancelled, [w____] [m____] we'll need a taxi.

cards.en: What matters most to me is how long the battery lasts.
cards.zh: 对我来说最要紧的是电池能撑多久。
cards.trigger_context: 选一台电脑，你对外观不在意，最在意续航。
cards.disambiguator: 在多个条件里只挑最优先的一项。
cards.usage_boundary: 可以说 what matters most to me is...，表示个人取舍。
cards.feynman_hook: 别的条件都能谈，我先说哪一项最不能少。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 选课时说明最重视能随时提问。
cards.transfer_example_en: What matters most is being able to ask questions whenever I need to.
cards.cloze_prompt: [W___] [m______] [m___] to me is how long the battery lasts.

cards.en: The main reason I moved here was to walk in the park more often.
cards.zh: 我搬到这里主要是为了能经常去公园散步。
cards.trigger_context: 解释为什么换到公园附近住，最重要的是想常散步。
cards.disambiguator: 把很多原因缩到一个主因。
cards.feynman_hook: 原因可以有好几个，我先交代最关键的那个。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 解释为什么选周末上课。
cards.transfer_example_en: The main reason I chose the weekend class was my work schedule.
cards.cloze_prompt: [T__] [m___] [r_____] I moved here was to walk in the park more often.

cards.en: It comes down to how much time we have before dinner.
cards.zh: 归根结底得看晚饭前我们还有多少时间。
cards.trigger_context: 比较两条路线后意识到关键在时间。
cards.disambiguator: 已经比较过一堆细节，现在把决定收束到单个取舍。
cards.usage_boundary: 后面可接名词或 how、whether 等引出的从句。
cards.feynman_hook: 前面细节很多，最后真正让决定落地的是这一条。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 比较两套房后指出最重要的考量。
cards.transfer_example_en: For me, it comes down to the length of the commute.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I_] [c____] [d___] [t_] how much time we have before dinner.

cards.en: The rent is low. On the other hand, it's far from work.
cards.zh: 房租低，但另一方面，它离上班的地方很远。
cards.trigger_context: 房子便宜但离工作地点远，你需要把两面讲清楚。
cards.disambiguator: 引出对立的一面。
cards.usage_boundary: 通常与前一句有明显张力。
cards.feynman_hook: 先把账的一边摆出来，再从另一边看看代价。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 说到活动很受欢迎，也指出排队要很久。
cards.transfer_example_en: It's a popular event. On the other hand, the queues can be awful.
cards.cloze_prompt: The rent is low. [O_] [t__] [o____] [h___], it's far from work.

cards.en: I want people to work independently. At the same time, we need to stay in touch.
cards.zh: 我希望大家独立做事，同时我们也得保持沟通。
cards.trigger_context: 你希望同事自主，又担心信息不同步。
cards.disambiguator: 同时承认两个需求或事实。
cards.feynman_hook: 第一件事成立，第二个顾虑也同样值得放在眼前。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 可以接受作业多，但希望老师给清楚反馈。
cards.transfer_example_en: I don't mind the workload. At the same time, I'd like clearer feedback.
cards.cloze_prompt: I want people to work independently. [A_] [t__] [s___] [t___], we need to stay in touch.

cards.en: It rained all morning. Even so, we decided to play.
cards.zh: 下了一早上雨，即便如此，我们还是决定上场。
cards.trigger_context: 知道天气不理想，还是决定参加比赛。
cards.disambiguator: 前一句给出阻力，后一句说在那个条件下仍成立的结果。
cards.usage_boundary: 常放在独立短句的开头，之后交代顶着困难仍然作出的选择。
cards.feynman_hook: 情况确实会妨碍我，最后我还是决定照做。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 强调虽然准备不足，仍然愿意去面试。
cards.transfer_example_en: I didn't have much time to prepare. Even so, I went to the interview.
cards.cloze_prompt: It rained all morning. [E___] [s_], we decided to play.

cards.en: A better lock will save us money in the long run.
cards.zh: 长远来看，好一点的锁能帮我们省钱。
cards.trigger_context: 比较维修和换新，想说明长期哪种更省。
cards.disambiguator: 看长期累积的影响。
cards.feynman_hook: 别只算今天这一次，把一年以后也算进去看看。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 解释每天花一点时间整理笔记的长期价值。
cards.transfer_example_en: Keeping my notes tidy saves time in the long run.
cards.cloze_prompt: A better lock will save us money [i_] [t__] [l___] [r__].

cards.en: Let's use the desk lamp for now.
cards.zh: 眼下先用台灯吧。
cards.trigger_context: 新灯还没买，先用桌上的旧灯顶几天。
cards.disambiguator: 已经要先定一个临时选择，后面仍可能改变。
cards.usage_boundary: 常放在句尾修饰当前做法，适合有明确临时方案时。
cards.feynman_hook: 眼下先这样安排，等情况明了还有回头调整的机会。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 一场活动还没敲定地点，先保留原计划。
cards.transfer_example_en: Let's keep the original venue for now.
cards.cloze_prompt: Let's use the desk lamp [f__] [n__].

cards.target_chunk: at the end of the day
cards.chunk_in_sentence: at the end of the day
cards.en: At the end of the day, I just want somewhere quiet to sleep.
cards.zh: 说到底，我只是想找个安静睡觉的地方。
cards.trigger_context: 讨论过房型和家具后，你说最在意住得安静。
cards.disambiguator: 口语收束到最实际的标准。
cards.feynman_hook: 把所有顾虑都摆一遍，最后能决定取舍的是这一条。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 回顾活动是否成功，强调参与者有收获。
cards.transfer_example_en: At the end of the day, people came and learned something useful.
cards.cloze_prompt: [A_] [t__] [e__] [o_] [t__] [d__], I just want somewhere quiet to sleep.

cards.en: All in all, it was a good trip, even with the delay.
cards.zh: 总的来说旅行很不错，虽然路上晚点了。
cards.trigger_context: 旅程晚点但玩得很开心，要做总体评价。
cards.disambiguator: 概括整体感受。
cards.usage_boundary: 可把前面的优缺点合在一起。
cards.feynman_hook: 零星的不便也算进去，整趟体验总体还是不错。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 总结新食堂第一次体验。
cards.transfer_example_en: All in all, the new canteen is an improvement.
cards.cloze_prompt: [A__] [i_] [a__], it was a good trip, even with the delay.

cards.en: Long story short, I found my wallet in the laundry basket.
cards.zh: 长话短说，我在洗衣篮里找到钱包了。
cards.trigger_context: 铺垫太多，你直接告诉朋友结果。
cards.disambiguator: 省去经过，直接交代要点或结果。
cards.feynman_hook: 故事前后很长，我直接告诉你后来发生了什么。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 跳过来回沟通，直接说酒店退款了。
cards.transfer_example_en: Long story short, the hotel gave us a refund.
cards.cloze_prompt: [L___] [s____] [s____], I found my wallet in the laundry basket.

units.title: 表达修正、接回话题
units.goal: 在说错细节、跑题或被打断时自然把话接回去。

cards.en: Let me rephrase that. We can lower the risk, but we can't remove it.
cards.zh: 让我换个说法。我们能降低风险，但无法消除风险。
cards.trigger_context: 你发现刚才的话太笼统，想换一种更准确的表达。
cards.disambiguator: 确实重新组织句子。
cards.feynman_hook: 刚才说得绕，我换句更好懂的话给你听。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 把对房间的含糊评价说得具体一点。
cards.transfer_example_en: Let me rephrase that. The room is quiet, but the light is poor.
cards.cloze_prompt: [L__] [m_] [r_______] [t___]. We can lower the risk, but we can't remove it.

cards.en: I run every week. Well, most weeks, I should say.
cards.zh: 我每周都跑步。嗯，更准确地说，是大部分周都跑。
cards.trigger_context: 你先说每周跑步，想改成大部分周都会跑。
cards.disambiguator: 自己主动收窄刚才的措辞，例如把每次改成大多数时候。
cards.usage_boundary: 可放在改正后的措辞之后作插入语，也可用 I should say... 引出更准确版本。
cards.feynman_hook: 那句话说得太满，我给刚才的程度改准一点。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 把「全部座位都满」改成「几乎满了」。
cards.transfer_example_en: The room was full, or nearly full, I should say.
cards.cloze_prompt: I run every week. Well, most weeks, [I_] [s_____] [s__].

cards.en: I'm moving there, or rather, I'm staying there for a month.
cards.zh: 我要搬过去。更确切地说，是先在那里住一个月。
cards.trigger_context: 你刚说会搬家，实际上是先去短住。
cards.disambiguator: 在一句话还没说完时，当场用更准确的片段替换上一段。
cards.usage_boundary: 通常紧跟要改的片段，整句推翻时需要另起一句。
cards.feynman_hook: 我留下原句的一半，只换掉刚刚说错的那个词。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 把刚说的下午更正为中午。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'll call this afternoon, or rather, around noon.
cards.cloze_prompt: I'm moving there, [o_] [r_____], I'm staying there for a month.

cards.en: I take that back. Someone's opening the door now.
cards.zh: 我收回刚才的话。现在有人正在开门。
cards.trigger_context: 刚说店关门，却看见有人在开门。
cards.disambiguator: 撤回一项判断。
cards.feynman_hook: 刚才那句我说得太早了，现在收回来。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 发现桌上的并非自己的钥匙。
cards.transfer_example_en: I take that back. These aren't my keys.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I_] [t___] [t___] [b___]. Someone's opening the door now.

cards.target_chunk: I lost my train of thought
cards.chunk_in_sentence: I lost my train of thought
cards.en: I lost my train of thought. Where was I?
cards.zh: 我刚才思路断了。我说到哪儿了？
cards.trigger_context: 讲经历中间被打断，突然记不起要接哪句。
cards.disambiguator: 描述思路中断。
cards.feynman_hook: 刚才那一串想法断掉了，我得找回停在哪一格。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 会议中有人插话，你请求同事提醒。
cards.transfer_example_en: I lost my train of thought. Could you remind me what I was saying?

cards.en: As I was saying, it might be easier to start on Monday.
cards.zh: 接着我刚说的，我们从周一开始可能更方便。
cards.trigger_context: 有人插了一句话，你想回到自己未讲完的建议。
cards.disambiguator: 回到刚中断的内容。
cards.feynman_hook: 话被截了一下，我现在把自己那句接完。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 服务员离开后继续给朋友讲刚才的故事。
cards.transfer_example_en: As I was saying, the dog followed me all the way home.
cards.cloze_prompt: [A_] [I_] [w__] [s_____], it might be easier to start on Monday.

cards.en: Where were we? Right, we were talking about the budget.
cards.zh: 我们刚才讲到哪儿了？对，在谈预算。
cards.trigger_context: 中途一起处理了别的事，回来继续讨论。
cards.disambiguator: 找回双方谈到的位置。
cards.feynman_hook: 我们一起停过一会儿，现在找找共同聊到哪一段。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 课程临时断网后恢复授课。
cards.transfer_example_en: Where were we? Oh yes, the second example.
cards.cloze_prompt: [W____] [w___] [w_]? Right, we were talking about the budget.

cards.en: Going back to the transport plan, who's driving on Saturday?
cards.zh: 回到刚才的交通安排，周六谁开车？
cards.trigger_context: 讨论转到新问题，你想回到交通安排。
cards.disambiguator: 已有一个聊过的具体话题要重新接上。
cards.usage_boundary: going back to 后最好直接说清要回到哪个人、项目或问题。
cards.feynman_hook: 现在聊远了，我把话拉回前面已经开始谈的事情。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 讨论跑偏后再谈钥匙交接。
cards.transfer_example_en: Going back to the keys, can I pick them up tomorrow?
cards.cloze_prompt: [G____] [b___] [t_] the transport plan, who's driving on Saturday?

cards.en: That reminds me, I still have your travel adapter.
cards.zh: 这倒提醒我了，你的旅行转换插头还在我这儿。
cards.trigger_context: 对方说到旅行，你突然想起来还有东西要还。
cards.disambiguator: 由前一句联想到相关事。
cards.feynman_hook: 听见你说这件事，我一下想起另一件相关的事。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 听到猫咪的事想起要给兽医打电话。
cards.transfer_example_en: That reminds me, I need to call the vet before five.
cards.cloze_prompt: [T___] [r______] [m_], I still have your travel adapter.

cards.en: By the way, are you still free for dinner tonight?
cards.zh: 顺便问一下，你今晚还有空一起吃饭吗？
cards.trigger_context: 快结束闲聊时，想补问今晚是否吃饭。
cards.disambiguator: 引出旁支话题。
cards.usage_boundary: 不要求和上一句有强关联。
cards.feynman_hook: 我临时插一句旁边的事，说完可以再回主线。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 临挂电话时补问对方要不要带雨伞。
cards.transfer_example_en: By the way, do you need an umbrella?
cards.cloze_prompt: [B_] [t__] [w__], are you still free for dinner tonight?

cards.en: Speaking of films, have you seen the new one at the Odeon?
cards.zh: 说到电影，你看过 Odeon 正在放的新片吗？
cards.trigger_context: 朋友提起电影，你联想到另一个想推荐的片子。
cards.disambiguator: 前一句已经提到一个名称或主题，下一句沿同一线索过渡。
cards.usage_boundary: 后面直接接名词或名词短语，接着说联想到的话题。
cards.feynman_hook: 你正好提到这个，我顺着它问一件很相关的事。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 听见对方说骑车，问对方车是否修好了。
cards.transfer_example_en: Speaking of bikes, did you manage to fix yours?
cards.cloze_prompt: [S_______] [o_] films, have you seen the new one at the Odeon?

cards.en: Before I forget, your parcel is at my place.
cards.zh: 趁我没忘，你的包裹在我那儿。
cards.trigger_context: 谈话中你想立刻交代一件怕忘的小事。
cards.disambiguator: 及时插入有时效的事情。
cards.feynman_hook: 先把这条消息告诉你，免得过一会儿真忘了。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 想在结束聊天前提醒对方开会时间。
cards.transfer_example_en: Before I forget, the meeting starts at ten.
cards.cloze_prompt: [B_____] [I_] [f_____], your parcel is at my place.

cards.en: I didn't catch your last name.
cards.zh: 我没听清你的姓。
cards.trigger_context: 对方报了名字，你只漏了姓。
cards.disambiguator: 指出没听到的具体内容。
cards.feynman_hook: 前半段听到了，可刚才那个名字没听清。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 餐厅服务员刚才说了最新一道汤，你没听清。
cards.transfer_example_en: I didn't catch the name of the soup.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I_] [d_____] [c____] your last name.

cards.en: Did I hear you right? The tickets are only five dollars?
cards.zh: 我没听错吧？票只要五美元？
cards.trigger_context: 你似乎听到演出票只要五元，有点意外。
cards.disambiguator: 核对听得清但出乎意料的消息。
cards.feynman_hook: 消息听起来太出乎意料了，我想再确认耳朵有没有听错。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 确认同事是否真说今天就能收到结果。
cards.transfer_example_en: Did I hear you right? We'll get the results today?
cards.cloze_prompt: [D__] [I_] [h___] [y__] [r____]? The tickets are only five dollars?

cards.en: That's not what I meant. I only said it was far from the station.
cards.zh: 我说的不是那个意思。我只说它离车站远。
cards.trigger_context: 朋友以为你嫌他选的酒店差，你其实只是嫌远。
cards.disambiguator: 修正自己的意思被误解。
cards.feynman_hook: 你听成了另一个意思，我想纠正的是这个误会。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 澄清自己并未要求重新做全部材料。
cards.transfer_example_en: That's not what I meant. I was only asking about the first page.
cards.cloze_prompt: [T_____] [n__] [w___] [I_] [m____]. I only said it was far from the station.

cards.en: Sorry to interrupt, but the room is only booked until three.
cards.zh: 不好意思打断一下，房间只订到三点。
cards.trigger_context: 需要在讨论继续前补一个重要时间信息。
cards.disambiguator: 礼貌地短暂插话。
cards.feynman_hook: 我必须赶在话题继续前告诉你这一个细节。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 赶车离开前有一条紧急消息要说。
cards.transfer_example_en: Sorry to interrupt, but my train leaves in ten minutes.
cards.cloze_prompt: [S____] [t_] [i________], but the room is only booked until three.

cards.en: Can I jump in? I tried the same thing last week.
cards.zh: 我能插一句吗？我上周试过同样的方法。
cards.trigger_context: 几个人在讨论，你有一个相关建议。
cards.disambiguator: 征求加入当前对话。
cards.feynman_hook: 你们已经在讨论了，我想插一小句补一下。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 开会时补上一条别人没有提到的数据。
cards.transfer_example_en: Can I jump in? I have the latest figures here.
cards.cloze_prompt: [C__] [I_] [j___] [i_]? I tried the same thing last week.

cards.en: Go ahead. I can wait.
cards.zh: 你先说吧，我可以等。
cards.trigger_context: 两人同时开口，你把话轮让给对方。
cards.disambiguator: 给对方继续或开始的许可。
cards.feynman_hook: 你可以先说下去，轮到我时我再说。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 允许同事用会议室的插座。
cards.transfer_example_en: Go ahead and plug it in over there.
cards.cloze_prompt: [G_] [a____]. I can wait.

cards.en: You were saying something about the rent.
cards.zh: 你刚才在说房租的事。
cards.trigger_context: 你刚才被来电打断，回来请对方继续。
cards.disambiguator: 要把话轮交回对方，让对方接着说刚被打断的句子。
cards.usage_boundary: 接上对方说过的内容时常用升调，也可直接用 You were saying?。
cards.feynman_hook: 刚才打断你了，我还记得你讲到的地方，请接着说。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 打断朋友后请其继续讲旅行计划。
cards.transfer_example_en: You were saying you'd found a cheap flight?
cards.cloze_prompt: [Y__] [w___] [s_____] something about the rent.

cards.en: Anyway, back to the route. Do we turn left at the bridge?
cards.zh: 总之回到路线。我们是在桥头左转吗？
cards.trigger_context: 闲聊了几句，你想接回原来关于路线的讨论。
cards.disambiguator: 结束偏题并明确指出回到哪件事。
cards.feynman_hook: 这段插曲讲完了，我们接回之前那个话题。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 讲完插曲后接回会议的预算问题。
cards.transfer_example_en: Anyway, back to the budget. How much is still available?
cards.cloze_prompt: [A_____], [b___] [t_] the route. Do we turn left at the bridge?

units.title: 管理话轮、检查理解与收尾
units.goal: 邀请回应、控制讨论进度，并清楚地结束一段谈话。

cards.en: I stayed in on Saturday. How about you?
cards.zh: 周六我待在家里。你呢？
cards.trigger_context: 说完你在周末做了什么，顺势问回朋友。
cards.disambiguator: 把原来的问题交给对方。
cards.feynman_hook: 我答完我的情况了，现在把同一个问题交给你。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 告诉别人你喜欢喝茶，然后问对方。
cards.transfer_example_en: I usually have tea in the morning. How about you?
cards.cloze_prompt: I stayed in on Saturday. [H__] [a____] [y__]?

cards.en: What do you make of the new timetable?
cards.zh: 你怎么看新时间表？
cards.trigger_context: 看完活动方案，想问别人总体印象。
cards.disambiguator: 问别人对一条消息、一份安排或一个结尾的看法。
cards.usage_boundary: what do you make of 后接事物或刚发生的情形，常用于轻松的交流。
cards.feynman_hook: 我知道你看到了那件事，现在想听你怎么理解它。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 请朋友说说对刚看完那部片的看法。
cards.transfer_example_en: What do you make of the ending?
cards.cloze_prompt: [W___] [d_] [y__] [m___] [o_] the new timetable?

cards.en: I'd like to hear what you think about the new schedule.
cards.zh: 我想听听你对新安排的看法。
cards.trigger_context: 你先表达了自己的看法，想邀请尚未发言的人。
cards.disambiguator: 明确邀请别人贡献意见。
cards.feynman_hook: 我这边说完了，现在认真邀请你讲讲自己的意见。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 请同事说说用户是怎么使用旧系统的。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'd like to hear how customers use the current system.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I__] [l___] [t_] [h___] what you think about the new schedule.

cards.en: You need to sign in first. Does that make sense?
cards.zh: 你得先登录。这样讲清楚了吗？
cards.trigger_context: 你刚解释完一个步骤，想核对自己有没有说清。
cards.disambiguator: 检查对方是否跟上。
cards.feynman_hook: 刚才的步骤听明白了吗，我可以再说明一遍。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 解释换乘后问对方是否清楚。
cards.transfer_example_en: You switch lines at Central. Does that make sense?
cards.cloze_prompt: You need to sign in first. [D___] [t___] [m___] [s____]?

cards.target_chunk: are we on the same page
cards.chunk_in_sentence: are we on the same page
cards.en: Are we on the same page about who's sending the email?
cards.zh: 关于由谁发邮件，我们理解一致吗？
cards.trigger_context: 计划讨论结束，想确认大家都知道谁负责什么。
cards.disambiguator: 核对双方对安排的共识。
cards.feynman_hook: 我们各自理解的分工对得上吗，最好出发前对一下。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 确认大家是否都同意周二试运行。
cards.transfer_example_en: Are we on the same page about starting on Tuesday?
cards.cloze_prompt: [A__] [w_] [o_] [t__] [s___] [p___] about who's sending the email?

cards.en: Let's leave it there for today and talk again on Monday.
cards.zh: 我们今天先说到这儿，周一再聊。
cards.trigger_context: 讨论开始重复，时间也快到了。
cards.disambiguator: 礼貌结束当前讨论。
cards.usage_boundary: 是否之后继续看上下文。
cards.feynman_hook: 这个话题到这里已经谈够了，可以先收住。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 暂时结束已经绕了一圈的意见讨论。
cards.transfer_example_en: Let's leave it there and give everyone time to think.
cards.cloze_prompt: [L____] [l____] [i_] [t____] for today and talk again on Monday.

cards.en: We've done enough. Let's call it a day.
cards.zh: 我们做得够多了。今天就到这儿吧。
cards.trigger_context: 你们整理东西整理了一天，想收工休息。
cards.disambiguator: 建议结束当天的活动。
cards.feynman_hook: 今天的活儿干到这里，剩下的明天接着做。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 团队调试很晚，提议明天再继续。
cards.transfer_example_en: It's getting late, so let's call it a day.
cards.cloze_prompt: We've done enough. [L____] [c___] [i_] [a_] [d__].

cards.en: I'll let you go. Thanks for taking the time to call.
cards.zh: 那我不耽误你了。谢谢你抽空打电话。
cards.trigger_context: 电话里听到对方马上要上班，你准备结束通话。
cards.disambiguator: 礼貌给对方一个离开时机。
cards.feynman_hook: 我知道你还要忙，就不拉着你继续说了。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 发现朋友马上要上车，结束电话。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'll let you go before you miss your train.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I___] [l__] [y__] [g_]. Thanks for taking the time to call.

cards.en: Let's pick this up after lunch.
cards.zh: 午饭后我们接着谈这事。
cards.trigger_context: 今天谈不完，约另一个时间继续同一件事。
cards.disambiguator: 今天停的是这段对话，双方有意在稍后接着解决它。
cards.usage_boundary: 常接 after lunch、tomorrow 等时间，this 指刚才没谈完的事。
cards.feynman_hook: 这件事还没谈完，我们约个时点从这里接上。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 提议下周继续选场地。
cards.transfer_example_en: Let's pick this up when we meet again next week.
cards.cloze_prompt: [L____] [p___] [t___] [u_] after lunch.

cards.en: We'll try the new routine for a week and we'll see how it goes.
cards.zh: 新安排先试一周，我们看看进展。
cards.trigger_context: 安排只是尝试，还不知道能不能长期执行。
cards.disambiguator: 表达先尝试再观察。
cards.feynman_hook: 先让方案跑一小段时间，看看用起来到底怎样。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 新活动本来报名不多，先办一场再观察。
cards.transfer_example_en: We'll run one session and we'll see how it goes.
cards.cloze_prompt: We'll try the new routine for a week and [w____] [s__] [h__] [i_] [g___].

cards.en: Get a quote first, and let's take it from there.
cards.zh: 先拿到报价，之后再决定下一步。
cards.trigger_context: 计划还取决于能否拿到报价，先完成第一步。
cards.disambiguator: 从一个已知的下一步出发。
cards.feynman_hook: 先走眼前这一小步，等拿到结果再定后面的路。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 先核对活动场地有没有档期。
cards.transfer_example_en: See if the room is free, and let's take it from there.
cards.cloze_prompt: Get a quote first, and [l____] [t___] [i_] [f___] [t____].

cards.en: I'll get back to you once I've checked my calendar.
cards.zh: 我看过日程后再回复你。
cards.trigger_context: 有人问你能不能顶班，你得先看日程。
cards.disambiguator: 承诺查清或想好后再联系。
cards.feynman_hook: 等我查到确切信息，我会再主动来答复你。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 对维修价格没把握，先询价后再告诉对方。
cards.transfer_example_en: I'll get back to you as soon as I have a price.
cards.cloze_prompt: [I___] [g__] [b___] [t_] [y__] once I've checked my calendar.

cards.en: Keep me posted if the landlord gets back to you.
cards.zh: 房东回你了就告诉我一声。
cards.trigger_context: 朋友在等房东答复，你想知道后续怎么样。
cards.disambiguator: 请求对方之后更新消息。
cards.feynman_hook: 以后有变化时告诉我一声，我想知道结果。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 请同事告知包裹有没有送到。
cards.transfer_example_en: Keep me posted on whether the parcel turns up.
cards.cloze_prompt: [K___] [m_] [p_____] if the landlord gets back to you.

cards.en: Let's go over who's doing what before the guests arrive.
cards.zh: 客人来之前，我们一起过一遍各自的分工。
cards.trigger_context: 活动开始前，要和搭档核对职责。
cards.disambiguator: 按顺序一起检查现有内容。
cards.feynman_hook: 我们打开这份现成的内容，一项项看有没有遗漏。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 下班前过一遍明日事项。
cards.transfer_example_en: Let's go over tomorrow's tasks before we leave.
cards.cloze_prompt: [L____] [g_] [o___] who's doing what before the guests arrive.

cards.en: One thing at a time. Let's deal with the booking first.
cards.zh: 一件一件来。先处理预订。
cards.trigger_context: 几个人同时提问题，你先处理最紧急的一项。
cards.disambiguator: 把重叠的任务排开。
cards.feynman_hook: 几件事同时挤进来了，先办完面前这一件。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 向朋友说明要先修刹车再看轮胎。
cards.transfer_example_en: One thing at a time. Let's fix the brakes before we check the tyres.
cards.cloze_prompt: [O__] [t____] [a_] [a_] [t___]. Let's deal with the booking first.

cards.en: Let's stick to what we can decide today.
cards.zh: 我们先集中在今天能定下来的事。
cards.trigger_context: 讨论不断偏离，你想让大家聚焦当天要决定的事。
cards.disambiguator: 约束当前议题或做法。
cards.feynman_hook: 话题先固定在这一小块，其他部分留到后面。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 讨论照片时请朋友只选这几个备选方案。
cards.transfer_example_en: Let's stick to the options we already have.
cards.cloze_prompt: [L____] [s____] [t_] what we can decide today.

cards.en: That brings us to the last item on the agenda.
cards.zh: 这就说到今天议程的最后一项了。
cards.trigger_context: 前一件事讲完，顺势进入下一项议程。
cards.disambiguator: 前后两项有明确联系，借前一项的结论自然进入下一项。
cards.usage_boundary: 常接议题、问题或后续安排，适合主持讨论或说明思路。
cards.feynman_hook: 上一项说到这里，刚好能接着说下一项。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 讨论完工作日程后过渡到周末安排。
cards.transfer_example_en: That brings us to the question of weekend cover.
cards.cloze_prompt: [T___] [b_____] [u_] [t_] the last item on the agenda.

cards.en: To sum up, we'll meet earlier and bring our own lunch.
cards.zh: 总结一下，我们提前见面，各自带午餐。
cards.trigger_context: 讨论结束前要复述两条大家同意的决定。
cards.disambiguator: 概括已经讨论过的内容。
cards.feynman_hook: 刚才说得比较多，我把大家需要记住的两三点收一下。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 结束一次电话后总结修理时间和费用。
cards.transfer_example_en: To sum up, the repair is booked for Friday and costs fifty dollars.
cards.cloze_prompt: [T_] [s__] [u_], we'll meet earlier and bring our own lunch.

cards.en: We're getting off track. What do we actually need to decide?
cards.zh: 我们有点跑题了。眼下到底要决定哪件事？
cards.trigger_context: 谈着谈着，从解决问题变成了闲聊。
cards.disambiguator: 提示讨论偏离原目标。
cards.usage_boundary: 可接一个把话拉回的提议。
cards.feynman_hook: 越说越远了，先看看我们当初要解决什么。
cards.transfer_prompt_zh: 培训讨论偏到不相关的问题，提醒大家回到原题。
cards.transfer_example_en: We're getting off track. Let's finish the exercise first.
cards.cloze_prompt: [W____] [g______] [o__] [t____]. What do we actually need to decide?

cards.en: That's all from me. Is there anything you'd like to add?
